description.value: Snow Valley Lodging is a motel in the heart of downtown Fernie, B.C., offering a wide range of options from standard rooms and multi-bedroom suites to standalone tiny homes with full kitchens. It markets itself as a year-round adventure basecamp with a hot tub, complimentary laundry, and on-site bicycle borrowing for both summer and winter guests. The property is dog-friendly and positioned within walking distance of downtown restaurants and amenities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Snow Valley Lodging is an active motel in downtown Fernie offering rooms, suites, and tiny homes. Multiple suite pages explicitly mention 'bicycle borrowing' for summer and winter, and a 'Fernie Adventure Bike Tour' package appears in the navigation, indicating bike-friendly awareness; however, no secure overnight storage arrangement for guests' own bikes is described anywhere on the site. A phone number discrepancy exists between the contact page (1-250-423-4421, matching OSM) and the homepage footer pop-up (250-946-6339), which warrants flagging.
